name: Places365-Standard: A Large-Scale Scene Recognition Benchmark
description: Places365-Standard is a foundational scene recognition benchmark comprising 2,168,460 photographs across 365 scene categories (distinct from the ~8M image Places365-Challenge release). Part of the MIT Places2 database, it includes 1,803,460 training images, 36,500 validation images (100/class), and 328,500 test images (900/class) to benchmark visual scene perception and place categorization.
